question.prompt: A sign at the fish market says, “\(50 \%\) off, today only: half-pound packages for just \(\$3\) per package.” What is the regular price for a full pound of fish, in dollars?

solutions.explanation:
A \(50\%\) discount means the sale price is half the regular price. Therefore the regular price of a half-pound package is
\[
3\div\frac12=6\text{ dollars}.
\]
A full pound contains two half-pound packages, so its regular price is
\[
2\cdot6=\boxed{12}\text{ dollars},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
